source_note: Scale keys per the official 'Personality Belief Questionnaire – Short Form (PBQ-SF) Scoring Key' (A.C. Butler, 6/00) distributed in the same Beck Institute packet. Items 31/44/45/49/56 belong to one PD scale AND to Borderline (official overlap); the ten scales jointly cover all 65 items exactly once. The printed Z-score formulas (based on 683 psychiatric outpatients with mixed diagnoses) are recorded here but NOT implemented: raw sums only, no norms, no cut-offs. Official scoring defines no total score.
